title: go.mod marks the directly imported modernc.org/sqlite as // indirect
evidence: go.mod:15 `modernc.org/sqlite v1.60.1 // indirect` while store.go:7 imports `_ "modernc.org/sqlite"` directly; every entry in the go.mod:5-16 require block is tagged indirect
suggestion: Run `go mod tidy` so the direct dependency is listed without the // indirect marker

title: Tests discard json.Unmarshal errors
evidence: main_test.go:42 and main_test.go:95-96 call json.Unmarshal without checking the returned error, so a non-JSON response would surface only as a confusing zero-value assertion failure
suggestion: Check the Unmarshal error and t.Fatal on it

title: Oversized request body is reported as 400 'invalid JSON body' rather than 413
evidence: main.go:50 wraps the body in http.MaxBytesReader(nil, r.Body, 1<<20) and main.go:51-53 maps every decode error, including *http.MaxBytesError, to "invalid JSON body"
suggestion: Detect *http.MaxBytesError with errors.As and return 413 Request Entity Too Large

title: Enhancements beyond spec: Location header, year validation, id validation, 1 MiB body cap

suggestion: None — surfaced for cross-run comparison only
